scenario: Create project with first Future Step as Next Action
steps: Capture 'Plan product launch', open Processing, select Project, enter desired outcome, type Step 1, choose Next Action, set context/date/notes, save
expected_result: Project is created, inbox item is removed, Step 1 appears as a linked Next Action under the project

scenario: Create project with Calendar Event step
steps: Open an inbox item as Project, add a Future Step, choose Calendar Event, set start/end time and optional recurrence, save
expected_result: Project is created and the Calendar Event step appears in Calendar for the chosen time

scenario: Create project with Waiting For step
steps: Open an inbox item as Project, add a Future Step, choose Waiting For, enter Waiting on person and follow-up date, save
expected_result: Project is created and the Waiting For item appears in the Waiting For active list linked to the project

scenario: Delete a Future Step before saving
steps: Open an inbox item as Project, add two Future Steps, press Delete on one step, confirm the dialog, save
expected_result: Deleted step is removed from the form and is not created when the project is saved
